create_ArrayTypeFactory_fixed_shape: create a SQLAlchemy TypeDecorator for fixed-shape numpy arrays serialized to binary blobs
create_ArrayTypeFactory_variable_shape: create a SQLAlchemy TypeDecorator for variable-shape numpy arrays serialized to binary blobs
create_TupleTypeFactory: create a SQLAlchemy TypeDecorator for tuples of float or int values serialized via struct packing
create_Base_dataclass: create a SQLAlchemy declarative base class that converts subclasses to dataclasses
build_numpy_array_column: build a SQLAlchemy model column using ArrayTypeFactory to store numpy arrays as binary blobs
